class.name: NetwPhysicsStepper
class.brief_description: Steps a physics space on demand, so a rollback can advance it several times in one frame.
class.description:
Godot steps each physics space once per physics frame. Extend this class to step a space yourself, and install it with [method NetwMultiplayer.predict_stepper_install]. While an entity with [constant NetwSimulationHandle.SCHEDULE_STEPPED] is in that space, Networked stops the engine from stepping it and calls [method _step] once per tick instead, and again for each tick it replays. [codeblock] extends NetwPhysicsStepper
func _can_step() -> bool: return true
func _step(space: RID, delta: float) -> void: _solver.advance(space, delta)
api.predict_stepper_install(space_rid, MyStepper.new()) [/codeblock] Install [code]null[/code] to uninstall, and read the installed stepper back with [method NetwMultiplayer.predict_get_stepper]. Without a stepper, a [constant NetwSimulationHandle.SCHEDULE_STEPPED] entity runs as [constant NetwSimulationHandle.SCHEDULE_FRAME]. Once no such entity is left in the space, the engine steps it again as usual. Each tick, every entity in the space applies its input first, then [method _step] and [method _snapshot] run once for the whole space. Under [constant NetwPredict.RECONCILE_JOINT] a replay restores every entity, calls [method _restore] once, then steps each replayed tick the same way. Implement [method _snapshot] and [method _restore] only when the space holds bodies that are not entities, such as loose debris. Entities are restored by Networked.

method.name: _can_step
method.description: Return [code]true[/code] to accept a space. A stepper that returns [code]false[/code], or does not override this, is not installed.

method.name: _restore
method.description: Puts [param space] back into the state [method _snapshot] saved for [param tick]. Called once per replay, after every entity is restored and before the replayed ticks run.

method.name: _snapshot
method.description: Saves the current state of [param space] for [param tick]. Called after every [method _step].

method.name: _step
method.description: Advances [param space] by [param delta] immediately. Do not read or write entity state here.

method.name: can_step
method.description: Calls [method _can_step], or returns [code]false[/code] when it is not overridden.
